promptTemplate:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one reusable Dreamari glossary mascot reaction, transparent production cutout.
Attached Image 1 is the canonical character/style reference. Preserve its IDENTITY, proportions, lobe construction, face, palette and material. It is a reference for a NEW POSE, not a redesign.
SCENE: genuine transparent alpha with no background or floor shadow. One Dreamy cloud only.
STATE: {{STATE}}
POSE / ACTING: {{BRIEF}}
STYLE LOCK: {{STYLE}}
FRAME: square 1024x1024. Keep the cloud around 75-80% canvas width, centered on the same anchor at (512,535); leave at least 8% clear margin to ALL visible pixels including props. Keep apparent cloud body scale and cloud thickness consistent with the reference. Small props may use margins but never dominate or cover the face. Normal frontal/slight 3/4 camera at eye level. Full cloud silhouette visible, no cutoffs. Expressive change must be clearly visible at 100px, high quality at 240px.
INVARIANTS: floating cloud only. NO arms, hands, fingers, feet, legs, tail, neck, belly, human torso, clothing or other characters. Side cloud lobes remain attached cloud lobes, never reaching limbs. No extra cloud pieces. Never fatten, stretch, squeeze or inflate the silhouette to manufacture a new pose. No ugly facial distortion or scary glass marbles. Do not replace the character with an emoji. Mouth expression and eyelids may change for acting, face proportions otherwise fixed. No drawn motion trails.
TEXT: none. No lettering, numbers, punctuation, logos, watermark, UI, frame or speech bubble. No teaching answers baked into props.
Generate exactly one asset, not a sheet or collage.

themeLocks.drift: Preserve the exact attached Drift Dreamy character design and technique: satin shaded ivory-white cloud with subtle cool cyan-blue undersides, familiar central crown and scalloped side lobes, deep navy oval GLASS eyes with recessed depth, white star and catchlights, familiar small blue mouth. Compact cloud width:height near 1.36, never spherical, never a fat inflated pillow or a humanoid body. Soft upper-left studio illumination, sculpted volume and restrained surface highlights. No fuzz, clay texture, rubbery balloon material, fog, gaseous strands, outline or pixelation.

states.brief: A welcoming, buoyant 3/4 turn toward the learner. Whole cloud tilts 7 degrees clockwise with sparkling attentive eyes and a small open joyful mouth. No props. An inviting greeting through head/cloud acting, never a wave or human gesture.

animationPrompts.drift:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sprite sheet.
Image 1 is Dreamy's canonical IDENTITY reference. Preserve EXACT character and illustration style: sculpted satin ivory cloud, gentle cool cyan-blue underside shading, recessed deep navy GLASS star eyes, white catchlights, familiar small blue mouth, restrained dimensional lighting. Compact width:height around1.36. No outline, pixelation, clay texture, fog or rubber balloon look.
Make one transparent sheet with FOUR separate copies of ONE welcome POSE, arranged in a perfectly even 2 by 2 grid. Each quarter is an equal cell. Each cloud fits WITHIN the center 72% width and center 72% height of its cell. All pixels including props have clear margins. Absolutely no overlap between cells.
Acting: A welcoming, buoyant 3/4 turn toward the learner. Whole cloud tilts 7 degrees clockwise with sparkling attentive eyes and a small open joyful mouth. No props. An inviting greeting through head/cloud acting, never a wave or human gesture.
ANIMATION FRAMES: Top left = eyes open, original pose expression, resting small blue smile. Top right = same pose with both eyelids shut in a brief gentle blink. Bottom left = original eyes open, small open blue speaking mouth. Bottom right = original eyes open, narrower rounded speaking mouth. For a wink keep its closed eye closed in open frames. For happy closed mastery eyes keep happy arcs and blink softly. Everything except eyelids and mouth MUST be IDENTICAL in all four cells: same silhouette, position, size, gaze direction, props, shading and outline. These frames will be played consecutively, not a mood board. No body deformation or motion, no extra props between frames.
FLOATING CLOUD ONLY, familiar scalloped lobes and central crown, familiar navy oval star eyes. Normal compact proportions, never fat or vertically bloated. No hands, arms, feet, legs, torso, neck, clothing or other characters.
TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA surrounding each sprite. NO background, NO atmospheric glow, NO halo, NO floor shadow. NO colored backplate or checkerboard baked in. NO text, labels, numbers, panels, dividers or watermark.

states.brief: Teaching with a gentle conversational expression. Turn 12 degrees toward screen right, gaze slightly toward screen right, mouth naturally open in a small rounded speaking shape. Slight thoughtful rise of the eye line. Calm, capable, not surprised. No props.
